purpose: Supplement to the immutable batch-001 commitment file: publishes the committed population (league, player, club — no verdicts, no outcomes) so that third parties can verify sample selection and batch non-overlap; fixes the sampling rule; and registers the checksum of the private salt file that will be used at reveal time.
sampling_rule: score = sha256("SL-SAMPLE-v1|" + beacon + "|" + commitment_hash); select exactly the N smallest scores (hex ascending), N=100
reveal_order: 2: at season close, full-population outcomes computed, frozen, SHA-256 published BEFORE the beacon
3: public beacon read (first Bitcoin block mined on or after 2027-07-01 00:00 UTC)
4: payload+salt+outcome revealed only for the sampled entries
